tailor_calls.prompt:
You are selecting resume bullets for ONE job application. You SELECT and lightly
REFRAME — you never rewrite, never invent. Every bullet you output must be the
corpus bullet's own words, at most lightly trimmed for space. Every number must
appear in the source bullet, written as the FIGURE STYLE rule below says.

Return ONLY a JSON object:

{
  "positioning_id": "pos_...",          // pick the variant matching this role's archetype
  "selected": [
    {"bullet_id": "b_00X", "variant": "long|short",
     "rendered": "the bullet text as it should appear (source words, light trim only)"}
  ],
  "ordering_note": "one sentence on why this selection",
  "skills_line": ["8-12 entries copied EXACTLY from the SKILL INDEX, most relevant first; [] if it is empty"]
}

Selection rules:
- 8 to 12 bullets total, one-page budget.
- At least ONE bullet for every role marked REQUIRED in ROLES (the current role
  and every role that ended in the last few years). A role with no bullet is
  not shown as an empty header: an older one is folded into a single "Earlier
  experience" line.
- Order by relevance WITHIN each role; roles stay reverse-chronological.
- Cover the job's must-haves first, then its implied needs.
- Never select a bullet that would claim a title or tool in the NEVER CLAIM list,
  and never render a NEVER CLAIM phrase.
- FIGURE STYLE: confident. Apply only the rule for that style:
  - confident: state every number plainly. You may drop an approximation
    mark — "~", "about", "approximately", "roughly" — even on a bullet whose
    metric_confidence is "estimate" ("~40%" may read "40%"; "$8M" stays
    "$8M"). Everything else stays exactly as the source writes it: the same
    value and unit, no added precision ("~19%" may become "19%", never
    "19.4%"), a range stays the whole range ("6–10", never "10"), and "+",
    "up to", "under", "over" stay where the source has them and are never
    added ("up to $1.8M/yr", never "$1.8M a year"; "40+", never "40").
  - hedged: every number keeps its unit and the hedge right next to it
    ("~40%", "40+"). A bullet whose metric_confidence is "estimate" must keep
    its hedge (~, "roughly", "up to") — never render a flat assertion.
  In both styles a rate keeps its period exactly as the source writes it:
  "5–7 deals/month" never "5–7 deals" or "5–7 deals/week", "$8M … annually"
  never "$8M/month", "~$5.6M in annual bookings" never "$5.6M in bookings".
  "or more", "-plus" and "and up" are bounds too: never add one the source
  does not have.
- Variant choice: NEVER choose a variant that drops a number the other variant
  of the same bullet has — compare the long and short lines, and if one carries
  a figure the other lacks, choose the one with the figure. Among variants that
  keep every figure, prefer "long" for the 2-3 most relevant bullets and
  "short" for the rest. Light trimming never removes a number.

ROLE TRACK: sdr_bdr_manager

Track emphasis — what to lead with and which bullets win a close call. It
changes ORDER and SELECTION only: never a bullet's words, and never a claim the
corpus does not make. Apply only the line for the ROLE TRACK above:
- sdr_bdr: lead with the candidate's own prospecting record (meetings or
  opportunities created, pipeline sourced, new accounts), then outbound and
  cold-calling bullets, then any closing results.
- sdr_bdr_manager: team leadership, hiring, onboarding and coaching results,
  plus the candidate's own prospecting record (the credibility to coach reps
  doing that job).
- account_executive: individual quota results (% of quota, awards, deals
  closed), new-business wins and full-cycle closing.
- sales_exec: revenue growth, building and leading teams, planning and
  forecasting, and programs the candidate built.
- other (or a track not listed): no track emphasis — the rules above decide.

JOB: Manager, Sales Development at Fabrikam Payments
REQUIREMENTS:
{
 "must_have": [],
 "nice_to_have": [],
 "implied": []
}

CORPUS (the only allowed source material):
ROLES (reverse-chronological):
- role_haulmark | Haulmark · Regional Sales Manager · Mar 2024 – Present | REQUIRED: at least one bullet
- role_ledgerline | ledgerline · Head of Revenue Operations · Nov 2021 – Mar 2024 | REQUIRED: at least one bullet
- role_marlow | Marlow Payroll · Mid-Market Account Executive · May 2018 – Nov 2021 | REQUIRED: at least one bullet
- role_keyward | Keyward Security · Inside Sales Representative · Aug 2016 – May 2018
- role_old | Halvorsen Outfitters · Store Manager · Jun 2012 – Aug 2016

BULLETS:
- id:b_053 role:role_ledgerline conf:estimate
  long: Stood up a deal desk that reviews every non-standard quote for 30+ sellers, bringing the average discount down from ~19% to ~12%.
  short: Stood up a deal desk for 30+ sellers; average discount ~19% → ~12%.
- id:b_049 role:role_ledgerline conf:verified
  long: Launched usage-based pricing for the SMB lending line, adding $2.4M in net-new ARR in its first year across 600+ merchant accounts.
  short: Launched usage-based pricing for SMB lending: $2.4M net-new ARR in its first year (600+ merchant accounts).
- id:b_046 role:role_ledgerline conf:estimate
  long: Moved commission tracking off spreadsheets into Salesforce and rebuilt the sales reports in Looker, cutting the month-end commission run from ~6 days to 2.
  short: Commissions into Salesforce, reports into Looker; month-end commission run ~6 days → 2.
- id:b_052 role:role_haulmark conf:verified
  long: Led a team of 9 account executives, reporting to the General Manager, and built the channel-partner program from 3 to 17 reseller partners in ~18 months.
  short: Led 9 AEs; reported to the General Manager; grew channel partners 3 → 17 in ~18 months.
- id:b_047 role:role_haulmark conf:verified
  long: Grew the Northeast region from ~$3.2M to ~$5.6M in annual bookings, adding 41 new carrier accounts and routing ~18% of new bookings through reseller partners by 2025.
  short: Northeast bookings ~$3.2M → ~$5.6M a year; 41 new carrier accounts; ~18% partner-sourced by 2025.
- id:b_044 role:role_haulmark conf:estimate
  long: Turned a small pilot into a remote onboarding program for new carriers, cutting time to first dispatch by ~40% (2–3 carriers go live a month).
  short: Remote onboarding for new carriers; time to first dispatch cut ~40%.
- id:b_058 role:role_marlow conf:verified
  long: Made President's Club in 2019 and 2020, closing 124% and then 131% of annual quota on mid-market payroll deals.
  short: President's Club 2019 and 2020 (124%, then 131% of annual quota).
- id:b_041 role:role_keyward conf:estimate
  long: Closed free trials from small IT teams, 12–15 new accounts a month, and signed multi-site accounts at Nakatomi, Ashgrove and Pemberton Mills.
  short: Free trials to paid plans, 12–15 new accounts/mo; signed Nakatomi, Ashgrove, Pemberton Mills.
- id:b_057 role:role_ledgerline conf:none
  long: Wrote the territory-planning model the sales team uses each January.
  short: Wrote the sales team's territory-planning model.
- id:b_067 role:role_old conf:estimate
  long: Ran a 14-person outdoor-gear store through peak seasons, hiring and training 6–8 seasonal staff each spring.
  short: Ran a 14-person outdoor-gear store; 6–8 seasonal hires each spring.

POSITIONING VARIANTS:
- pos_ops (revenue operations): Builds the deal desks and pricing a sales team runs on.

NEVER CLAIM: titles ['VP', 'Vice President', 'SVP', 'CRO', 'Chief Revenue Officer', 'Head of Sales', 'Director of Sales', 'General Manager'], tools [], phrases ['treasury management sales']
SKILL INDEX (skills_line may use ONLY these exact strings): ['Channel Partnerships', 'Gong', 'MEDDIC', 'Salesforce']
